name: Whisper small
author: OpenAI (CTranslate2 conversion by Systran)
description: [Whisper](https://github.com/openai/whisper) `small` (244 M parameters, 99 languages), converted to CTranslate2 for [faster-whisper](https://github.com/SYSTRAN/faster-whisper) by Systran. The weights are float16; Load STT Model runs them in int8 on the CPU and float16 on a GPU.
